concepts.def: World Bank categories: High-Income Country (UK, US), Newly Emerging Economy (India, Brazil), Low-Income Country (Mali, DRC).
Human Development Index by UN: composite of life expectancy, education and GNI per capita; Norway 0.961, Niger 0.400.
1960 economic development model: traditional, preconditions, take-off, drive to maturity, mass consumption.
Top-down = large government projects (dams); bottom-up = small community schemes (e.g. WaterAid wells); latter more sustainable.
Five-stage model of birth/death rate as country develops; UK at Stage 4, Niger Stage 2, Japan Stage 5 (declining).
NEE with 1.4 billion people; IT sector (Bangalore), TNCs like Tata; persistent inequality and rural poverty.
